avertissement.profil_indisponible_du: {equipement} is due today but its profile is unavailable (status={status}): unable to size a time slot, schedule it manually.
avertissement.heures_insuffisantes_du: {equipement} is due today but there is not enough time left for a full cycle ({duree_min} from {debut_min}): not scheduled. If it has already run, check off the task in Home Assistant.
avertissement.profil_indisponible_attente: {equipement} is pending but its profile is unavailable (status={status}): not scheduled.
avertissement.dependance_non_placee: {equipement} must follow {depend_de}, which could not be scheduled today: not scheduled.
avertissement.heures_insuffisantes_attente: {equipement} is pending but there is not enough time left for a full cycle ({duree_min} from {debut_min}): not scheduled.
avertissement.contrainte_impossible: {equipement}: no time slot meets its time constraints ({contraintes}): not scheduled or minimum runtime not met.
avertissement.contrainte_non_respectee: {equipement}: soft constraint not met ({contraintes}) to keep the rest of the plan.
avertissement.prevision_open_meteo: Solar forecast computed by Open-Meteo from your panels: less accurate than a forecast integration in the Home Assistant Energy dashboard.
avertissement.prevision_horaire_indisponible: Hourly solar forecast unavailable or incomplete: falling back on the average shape of the last {jours} days, less faithful to today's weather.
avertissement.panneau_sans_historique: Panel {panneau}: not enough history ({jours} days), falling back on the average terrace shape.
avertissement.soc_depart_approximatif: Approximate starting SoC for tomorrow's forecast: current actual SoC used, as no usable plan for today is cached yet. It will be refined by later runs during the day.
avertissement.regle_recurrence_non_geree: {equipement}: unsupported recurrence rule, only its due date is used in the forecasts for the following days.
avertissement.tache_reportee: {equipement} postponed to {jour}: {pct_jour}% covered by solar, versus {pct_auj}% today.
avertissement.tache_reportee_sans_creneau: {equipement} postponed to {jour}: not enough time left today for a full cycle.
avertissement.puissance_souscrite_depassee: Planned grid draw above the contract power ({kva} kVA) at hours {heures}: base consumption and appliances exceed what the contract allows, even after moving the appliances. The main breaker may trip.
